mapper.select: SELECT t.register_status AS registerStatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_as_teacher t WHERE t.is_valid = 1 AND t.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY t.register_status
SELECT t.id teacherId, t.teacher_name FROM t_as_course_class c, t_as_teacher t WHERE c.teacher_id = t.id AND c.school_id = #{schoolId} AND c.id = #{courseId}

SELECT u.id, u.login_name, u.approve_status auditStatus FROM t_base_user u, t_as_teacher t WHERE u.phone = t.phone AND u.is_valid = 1 AND t.is_valid = 1 and u.school_id = #{schoolId} AND u.login_name = #{loginName}

SELECT DISTINCT t.phone FROM t_as_teacher t INNER JOIN t_base_user u ON u.phone = t.phone AND u.is_valid = 1 WHERE t.is_valid = 1 AND u.school_id = #{schoolId} AND u.approve_status = 0 AND t.phone IN
#{phone}
